fields.description: Answer customer questions on LINE with the configured LLM. Orders, confirmations and payment slips are unaffected.
fields.label: Enable LINE AI Assistant

fields.description: Enable the Typhoon-powered assistant for authenticated ERPNext staff.
fields.label: Enable Staff Chat

fields.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Typhoon accepts https://api.opentyphoon.ai or https://api.opentyphoon.ai/v1.
fields.label: AI Gateway URL

fields.description: Typhoon model used by the ERPNext staff assistant. Falls back to Chat Model when blank.
fields.label: Staff Chat Model

fields.description: Optional. When empty, knowledge search falls back to keyword matching.
fields.label: Embeddings Model

fields.description: Maximum ERP tool calls the assistant may make while answering one message
fields.label: Max Tool Calls per Message

fields.description: Maximum AI answers sent per day across all customers (0 disables the cap)
fields.label: Daily Answer Cap

fields.description: Maximum staff chat turns per day across the site (0 disables the cap).
fields.label: Staff Chat Daily Turn Cap

fields.description: Automatically remove staff chat sessions older than this many days (0 keeps them indefinitely).
fields.label: Chat History Retention (Days)

fields.description: Deployment switch for the separate Agent Runtime service. Each company must also enable it in its NextGen Automation Policy.
fields.label: Enable Agent Runtime

fields.description: Private base URL of the Agent Runtime, for example https://agent-runtime.internal:8400. Browser, LINE and Desk clients never call it directly.
fields.label: Agent Runtime URL

fields.description: Dispatch credential presented to the runtime. Rotated separately from the runtime's own Frappe API key.
fields.label: Agent Runtime Service Token

fields.description: Restricted, non-Desk user holding the NextGen Agent Runtime role. Used when a company policy does not name its own service user.
fields.label: Runtime Service User

fields.description: Transition-only operator switch that restores the embedded orchestration route. A runtime failure must never set this automatically.
fields.label: Legacy Orchestration Rollback
